rules.bounty: takeable only inside level range; half a level's XP flat; 1 Token; copper (placeholder)
rules.repeatable: 10 drops: 35% trash, 100% named cult mobs, boss drops 3; available dungeon level -4 to +4
rules.item: ITEM quests give a choice of one piece per fighter kind, like 900101-900104

storyQuests.title: McBride's Report
storyQuests.task: carry the sealed report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
storyQuests.story: McBride writes down what happened in the Abbey; Dughan is the one who has to act on it.

storyQuests.title: The Marshal's Doubt
storyQuests.task: ask Innkeeper Farley, Smith Argus and Remy "Two Times" whether anyone in Goldshire has seen the hammer-and-black-sun mark.
storyQuests.story: Dughan will not raise an alarm over one idol. Farley saw the mark on a crate from a wrecked cart; Argus has had strangers buying ore in bulk; Remy's biggest debtor skipped town the night the Abbey fell.

storyQuests.title: The Wrecked Cart
storyQuests.task: recover the Sealed Strongbox from the Defias Highwayman at the wrecked cart on the Stormwind road.
storyQuests.story: the strongbox holds Twilight coin and a letter addressed to "the Collector, Brackwell." Dughan still calls it a Defias matter, but he sends you south.

bounties.title: Prowlers on the Road
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Silk for the Smith
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Bandits on the Stormwind Road
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Gold Dust for Remy
bounties.task: Bring 8 Gold Dust (50% drop from Kobold Vermin and Tunnelers at the edge of Fargodeep)
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

storyQuests.title: The Collector's Letter
storyQuests.task: show the letter to Guard Thomas at the Stonefield–Maclure crossroads.
storyQuests.story: Thomas knows the name: Morgan has been buying up both families' debt for a year.

storyQuests.title: Princess
storyQuests.task: kill Princess, the elite boar wrecking the Maclure vineyard, and bring back her collar.
storyQuests.story: the collar is stamped with Morgan's mark. The pig was a gift to the Maclures, then let loose on Stonefield land.
storyQuests.reward: 3 silver. Optional ITEM: a small trinket; Princess is the first elite after Padfoot.

storyQuests.title: Mend the Fence
storyQuests.task: show the collar to Ma Stonefield and Joshua Maclure, then bring both to Thomas.
storyQuests.story: the feud was bought. Both farms open as vendors.

storyQuests.title: Morgan the Collector
storyQuests.task: kill Morgan the Collector, elite, in Brackwell manor, and bring his ledger.
storyQuests.story: the ledger lists Defias wages paid in Twilight coin, and "road to the Landing: keep clear."
storyQuests.reward: 8 silver, plus a choice of one of Morgan's items, one for each kind of fighter. ITEM.

bounties.title: Thugs in the Pumpkin Patch
bounties.task: Kill 10 Defias Thugs or Defias Pillagers at Brackwell
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Boars in the Vineyard
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Pumpkins for Bernice
bounties.task: Gather 8 Ripe Pumpkins from the Brackwell patch (guarded)
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Boar Ribs for the Inn
bounties.task: Bring 8 Boar Ribs (50% drop from Stonetusk Boars)
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

storyQuests.title: Narg's Orders
storyQuests.task: kill Narg the Taskmaster, elite, at the bottom of Fargodeep and bring his journal.
storyQuests.story: Morgan's ledger listed ore from Fargodeep. Narg's journal says the kobolds fled Jasperlode because "the ones who dig down, not across" took it from them.
storyQuests.reward: 6 silver, plus a choice of one of Narg's items. ITEM.

storyQuests.title: The Dead Courier
storyQuests.giver: Starts from the Courier's Satchel on the dead gryphon at the lake's north shore.
storyQuests.task: bring the satchel to Marshal Dughan.
storyQuests.story: inside is a Stormwind dispatch: cult activity confirmed in Redridge, Elwynn considered clear. Dughan now knows Stormwind is wrong.

storyQuests.title: The Keystone
storyQuests.giver: Foreman Gorn at the Fargodeep entrance gives it.
storyQuests.task: recover the rune-marked keystone from Gllrg the Tidecaller, the named murloc at Crystal Lake.
storyQuests.story: the murlocs looted the sealed Jasperlode entrance; the keystone opens its inner door.

bounties.title: Kobolds in Fargodeep
bounties.task: Kill 10 Kobold Tunnelers or Kobold Geomancers
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Candles for Gorn
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Murlocs on the Shore
bounties.task: Kill 10 Murloc Foragers or Murloc Lurkers
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Fins for Lee Brown
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

storyQuests.title: Into Jasperlode
storyQuests.task: open the sealed door with the keystone and find Chieftain Grik's camp inside.
storyQuests.story: the mine is split: kobolds above, cult diggers below.

storyQuests.title: The Kobold King's Plea
storyQuests.giver: Chieftain Grik gives it and takes it back.
storyQuests.task: kill the Deep Overseer at the bottom of the mine.
storyQuests.story: Grik swears his people will leave Elwynn if the thing below dies. Players can honor that or wipe the camp on the way out.
storyQuests.reward: 10 silver, plus a choice of one of the Overseer's items. ITEM.

storyQuests.title: What Narg Feared
storyQuests.task: bring Dughan the Overseer's orders.
storyQuests.story: the orders carry the same mark as the idol from Echo Ridge, in the same hand. Dughan stops calling it a Defias matter.

repeatable.title: Resonant Ore
repeatable.dropRates: Deep Kobolds 35%, Twilight Diggers always, the Deep Overseer always drops three.

storyQuests.title: The Vigil Defaced
storyQuests.giver: Grave-tender Ilsa at Heroes' Vigil gives it.
storyQuests.task: clean 5 cairn stones of the painted mark, then kill the 6 Twilight Daubers who come back at dusk.
storyQuests.story: low-level cultists, and they run when hit. The mark is the one from Echo Ridge.

storyQuests.title: Rites at the Stone
storyQuests.task: hold the cairn through one night against three waves of cultists, then kill Ritualist Serane, elite, who leads the last one.
storyQuests.story: Serane's orders read "the tower is ready; the tribute moves by water."
storyQuests.reward: 8 silver, plus a choice of one of Serane's items. ITEM.

storyQuests.title: An Echo in the Ore
storyQuests.giver: Starts from the Resonant Shard that Serane drops.
storyQuests.task: bring the shard to Toren, Theocritus's apprentice, at the base of the Tower of Azora.
storyQuests.story: Toren recognizes it from the tower's experiments and goes pale.

bounties.title: Murlocs at the Cairn
bounties.task: Kill 10 Murloc Nestguards or Murloc Tidehunters
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Nests to Burn
bounties.task: Burn 6 Murloc Nests on the island
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Riverpaw Scouts
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Scout Markings
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

storyQuests.title: The Tower Is Open
storyQuests.task: enter the tower and re-attune the 4 ward stones, one through each floor's portal.
storyQuests.story: each ward you fix pins one portal in place. Toren admits Theocritus has not been seen in a week, and that the portals "keep opening on Redridge."

storyQuests.title: The Apprentice's Secret
storyQuests.giver: Starts from Toren's Sale Note, found on the third floor.
storyQuests.task: confront Toren at the tower base.
storyQuests.story: the buyer signed as "M., Ilgalar." Toren knew exactly who that was. Hand him to Dughan or let him run; if he runs he turns up at Ridgepoint (94704).

storyQuests.title: Theocritus Unbound
storyQuests.giver: Theocritus gives it from the top chamber.
storyQuests.task: kill the Shadow of Morganth and close the master portal.
storyQuests.story: the projection breaks and the tower is Theocritus's again. He is furious in a way the player has not seen from him.
storyQuests.reward: 12 silver, plus a choice of one of the Shadow's items, and a one-use Azora teleport scroll. ITEM.

storyQuests.title: Where It Pointed
storyQuests.task: tell Dughan what the portals showed.
storyQuests.story: the cult's people went to Ridgepoint Tower on the Eastvale ridge; Morganth himself never left Ilgalar. Dughan writes a letter for Supervisor Raelen and tells Theocritus that Redridge is not his jurisdiction. Theocritus does not agree.

repeatable.title: Ward Shards
repeatable.dropRates: Shadowhide Gnolls 35%, Twilight Portalists and Voidwalkers always, the Shadow of Morganth always drops three.

storyQuests.title: Timber for the Pit
storyQuests.task: kill Defias Overseer Hadrik at the east sawmill and take his manifest.
storyQuests.story: the timber is cut to scaffold lengths and addressed to "the Landing, for the pit."

storyQuests.title: Eyes on the Ridge
storyQuests.giver: Raelen gives it, with Dughan's letter.
storyQuests.task: reach the three overlooks above Ridgepoint and count the banners without being seen.
storyQuests.story: no kills; the cult holds an Alliance watchtower in daylight.

storyQuests.title: Ridgepoint Falls
storyQuests.task: storm the tower and kill Speaker Vael, elite, at the top.
storyQuests.story: Vael's last words: "the gnoll was promised power; he digs for us."
storyQuests.reward: 10 silver, plus a choice of one of Vael's items. ITEM.

storyQuests.title: Toren's Trail
storyQuests.requiresNote: 94602, and only if Toren was let go
storyQuests.giver: Starts from Toren's Pack in the Ridgepoint cellar.
storyQuests.task: find Toren chained in the cellar and decide: free him, or leave him for Dughan.
storyQuests.story: the cult did not pay him; they kept him.

bounties.title: Looters in the Camp
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Lumber Recovery
bounties.task: Bring 8 Eastvale Lumber (50% drop from Looters)
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Bears on the Ridge
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Hides for Tomas
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Acolytes at Ridgepoint
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

storyQuests.title: Remy's Last Debtor
storyQuests.task: find Dobbs, the debtor who skipped town, at Jerod's Landing.
storyQuests.story: Dobbs keeps the smugglers' ledger now. He trades the shipping schedule for his life and Remy's forgiveness.

storyQuests.title: The Smugglers' Ledger
storyQuests.task: destroy 6 Twilight supply caches along the docks.
storyQuests.story: each cache is a different stolen Elwynn good: ore, timber, pumpkins, relics.

storyQuests.title: The Pit
storyQuests.giver: Sergeant Keane at the Mirror Lake outpost gives it.
storyQuests.task: go down into the Landing's cellar and kill Acolyte Marren, elite, at the dig.
storyQuests.story: Marren's orders: "Hogger's camp is the staging ground. Move at the new moon."
storyQuests.reward: 10 silver, plus a choice of one of Marren's items. ITEM.

storyQuests.title: Burn the Boats
storyQuests.task: torch the 3 smuggler skiffs before they go upriver toward Lake Everstill.
storyQuests.story: the supply line is cut and the finale is a race to the new moon.

bounties.title: Riverpaw at Mirror Lake
bounties.task: Kill 10 Riverpaw Brutes or Riverpaw Shamans
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Twilight Fetishes
bounties.task: Bring 8 Twilight Fetishes (50% drop from Shamans)
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Smugglers on the Docks
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Contraband
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

storyQuests.title: Reinforce Westbrook
storyQuests.task: escort a supply wagon from Goldshire to Westbrook through two gnoll ambushes.
storyQuests.story: Westbrook is the forward hub from here on.

storyQuests.title: Ragtooth
storyQuests.task: kill Ragtooth, elite, the gnoll captain at the river crossing, and take his horn.
storyQuests.story: the horn is how Hogger's camp calls its gnolls to a gate.
storyQuests.reward: 8 silver, plus a choice of one of Ragtooth's items. ITEM. The horn is a separate quest item kept for the raid.

storyQuests.title: The Camp by Daylight
storyQuests.task: reach three vantage points on the ridge above Hogger's camp.
storyQuests.story: the player gets a sketch map marking the gates, the kennels and the Twilight tent.

storyQuests.title: Poison the Dogs
storyQuests.task: gather 6 Nightshade on the riverbank and bring them back for Tainted Meat.
storyQuests.story: optional; the camp's wolves sleep through the raid if the meat is used.

storyQuests.title: The Night Watch
storyQuests.task: subdue a Riverpaw Nightwatch and bring him back alive.
storyQuests.story: he gives up the sentry rotation; the player learns the safest hour to go in.

storyQuests.title: New Moon
storyQuests.task: report ready.
storyQuests.story: the raid is set for the night the cultists named.

bounties.title: Mongrels on the Road
bounties.task: Kill 10 Riverpaw Mongrels or Riverpaw Outrunners
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Riverpaw Collars
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Nightshade
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

bounties.title: Hogger's Patrols
bounties.task: Kill 10 Riverpaw Raiders on the Forest's Edge trail
bounties.xp: half a level, flat across range

storyQuests.title: Into the Camp
storyQuests.task: get inside Hogger's camp after dark and reach the Twilight tent.
storyQuests.story: the whole camp is awake and waiting for the new moon.

storyQuests.title: The Tribute
storyQuests.giver: Dughan's letter, carried from 94906, gives it.
storyQuests.task: take the sealed Tribute crate from the Twilight tent before it leaves.
storyQuests.story: the crate is marked for the Tower of Ilgalar; what is inside is the hook into Redridge.

storyQuests.title: Free the Prisoners
storyQuests.giver: Starts from Scout Hale, caged in the camp.
storyQuests.task: free the 4 captured Westbrook scouts and Eastvale lumberjacks.
storyQuests.story: optional; the freed NPCs turn up at the garrison afterward.

storyQuests.title: Hogger
storyQuests.task: kill Hogger, elite.
storyQuests.story: the zone's capstone. If the Stockades exist, capture is the alternate turn-in.
storyQuests.reward: 20 silver, plus a choice of one of Hogger's items, one for each kind of fighter. ITEM: the big one.

storyQuests.title: Marshal Dughan's Report
storyQuests.task: return with the Tribute and word of Hogger.
storyQuests.story: Dughan writes to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire; the exit quests carry it.

repeatable.title: Twilight Relics of the Camp
repeatable.dropRates: Riverpaw Cultists 35%, Twilight Zealots always, Hogger always drops three.

storyQuests.title: A Letter for Lakeshire
storyQuests.task: carry Dughan's letter over the Lakeridge Highway to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
storyQuests.story: Dughan has written down everything from the Abbey to Hogger's camp. Solomon reads it and says Redridge has worse problems than a cult, and he means the Blackrock orcs.

storyQuests.title: Theocritus's Grudge
storyQuests.task: take his sealed challenge to the foot of the Tower of Ilgalar and leave it on the door.
storyQuests.story: Theocritus will not let Morganth keep what he stole. Shadowhide gnolls watch the player do it and do not attack; Morganth wants it delivered.

storyQuests.title: What the Tribute Was For
storyQuests.giver: Starts from the Tribute crate once Theocritus has examined it.
storyQuests.task: bring Theocritus's findings to Magistrate Solomon.
storyQuests.story: whatever is in the crate, Morganth was paying the cult to dig it up under Elwynn and float it up the river to Everstill. Solomon finally takes the cult seriously; the Redridge arc opens from here.
